moment.js CVEs bundled in chart.js@2.9.4 (Chart.bundle.min.js). CVE-2022-24785 (path traversal in moment.locale) is Node-only, not exploitable in the browser. CVE-2022-31129 (ReDoS on very long date strings) requires user-controlled input into moment.parse, which does not occur - chart.js on the metadata-quality page renders backend-controlled numbers only. Both are resolved by chart.js v2 -> v4 upgrade tracked in GOVDATADE-XXXX (moment is no longer bundled in chart.js v3+).
